The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, matching the sales-rep list.

The change is one SQL `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10021). I used the same `CASE` expression as the sales-rep query and updated the method's doc comment to match. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

`RegionManagerTest` (5 tests) and `SupportTicketTest` (5 tests) pass. I did not add a test that checks the new ordering against your T-1…T-5 example, so that case is covered by reading the query rather than by a test.

Nothing is committed.
